notes: *an ox goad* is rendered indefinitely, so the article on the rectum is unrepresented and the *an* belongs to the construct noun's expression, which is the noun of the phrase rather than its leftmost word (rules 15, 29).
The waw of `וַיַּךְ` carries the recast relative *who* (rule 17), and the object marker takes the *of* through which *smote* reaches its object (rule 16).
